verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents its own profile deletion and suppression through the Pipelines API ('Delete Person' / 'Suppress Person' events). The MCP server separates deletes as an independently approvable category, so AI-driven deletion is supported. Nothing in the evidence covers retention controls such as retention periods or automatic purging. missing for 10: data retention policy/configuration controls, workspace-level or bulk data deletion and purge documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of deletion behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: if you wanted to delete a profile, you'd send a track event with a name parameter called Delete Person. If you want to suppress a profile, you'd send an event called Suppress Person.
Reads are separated from writes and deletes... so you can approve each category independently.
